name: DEAD DETENTION 2 After Story
source:
This is a bonus "After Story" episode of the 2nd season of Dead Detention! It really just acts as a way to tie up some loose ends, and close out this chapter of the character's lives.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/681645]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
这是《死亡拘留所》第二季的额外“故事后”剧集！它实际上只是作为一种方式来解决一些未解决的问题，并结束角色生活的这一章。

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/681645]Newgrounds[/url]]
